text:
Waves travel across the surface of water.
What is meant by the amplitude of the wave?
A
the maximum distance of a water particle from its mean position
B
how far the wave travels every second
C
the number of waves passing a point every second
D
the distance between the top of consecutive waves

options.label: A
options.text: the maximum distance of a water particle from its mean position

options.label: B
